units: <cite ref="Ketubot 111b:18">Keth. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>פְּשָׁטֵיה דקרא במאי כתיב</he> what does the plain text (not homiletically changed) refer to?; <cite ref="Eruvin 23b:6">Erub. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>פשטיה דקרא וכ׳</he> what is the plain sense (not homiletically forced) of the text?; <cite ref="Kiddushin 80b">Kidd. 80ᵇ</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:1:6">Y. Snh. I, beg. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>פְּשׁוּטֵה דקרייא</he> the plain sense of the text.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 8:1:5">Y. B. Bath. VIII, 16ᵃ</cite> <he>בעי מימר פְשָׁטֵיה וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="Q01207"><he>פנסטה</he></cite>) wanted to give the meaning (of the verse) and could not find it.
<cite ref="Gittin 60b">Gitt. 60ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 18b">Ḥull. 18ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 57a">57ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00282"><he>נְהַר</he> II</cite>.
